Tandem runs in safe mode: reading works, changes wait.
read about safe mode
Safe mode
Tandem has not been tested with this Tandoor version. To keep your recipes and lists safe, it runs in safe mode until a tested version of Tandem is available.
What safe mode means
Reading works
Recipes, the meal plan and everything saved for offline use work as usual.
Changes wait on this device
Changes you make in Tandem, such as cook logs, are kept on this device and are not sent to the server yet.
“Send anyway” comes later
A later version of Tandem lets you send waiting changes anyway. Nothing you saved is thrown away.
What you can do
Update Tandem when a new version is out. The release notes say which Tandoor versions each version has been tested with.
Tandem releases on GitHub
Tandoor %1$s is too old
This Tandoor version is too old
Tandem needs Tandoor 2.0 or newer, so syncing and changes are turned off. Update Tandoor on your server and try again. You can log out under More.
